description: This file defines the 'Order' entity class within an e-commerce application, including properties for buyer ID, order date, shipping address, and order items, along with a method to calculate the total order value.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order with properties for buyer information, shipping address, order items, and total calculation logic.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new order instance with buyer ID, shipping address, and list of order items.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total cost of the order by summing the unit price times units for each order item.
